name: Avtar Singh
abstract_title: Resolving Collapse of Wavefunction and Quantum Foundational Paradoxes via Integrating New Physics of Particle Instability with Gravity
abstract: The missing physics behind the quantum measurement problem entailing collapse of the wavefunction or objective reduction (OR) has been a major unresolved problem leading to the well-known weirdness and foundational paradoxes of quantum mechanics. This paper describes the new relativistic physics of a spontaneously self-decaying or self-forming quantum particle and its spontaneous complementary wave-particle behavior.
